cases.title: Implementation follows the explicit versioned contract

cases.title: Debit bypasses the non-negative balance invariant

facts: The approved account contract forbids negative balances and requires rejected overdrafts to leave the balance unchanged.

cases.title: Database constraint preserves the invariant

facts: The same transaction writes through a database UNIQUE constraint and maps conflict to the documented no-op result.

cases.title: Settlement reserve may violate a documented funds invariant on an unproven caller

cases.title: Currency conversion multiplies an external provider debit

facts: The active public route and external payment-client contract both define the value in cents and the client performs an immediate irreversible debit.

cases.title: Rounding behavior is explicitly accepted by contract

facts: The approved contract explicitly requires bankers rounding and tests cover the boundary values.

cases.title: Settlement amount is multiplied without a client-unit contract

facts: A merchant-payout request is denominated in cents, but the settlement client unit, production amount range, and deployed caller are undocumented.

cases.title: Committed debit survives failed ledger write

facts: A stable ledger error returns failure after the debit transaction has committed.
No compensation, reconciliation, or idempotent retry restores the account balance.

cases.title: Outbox and idempotent reconciliation prove eventual consistency

cases.title: Multi-step write has unknown compensation guarantees

cases.title: Message retry repeats an irreversible payout

cases.title: Unique idempotency key prevents duplicate side effects

cases.title: Retryable side effect has undocumented provider idempotency
